Harrowfield’s households paid more per resident. Since the same tariff applies to both districts, compare water use per resident:

- Harrowfield: \(7,146,000 \div 90,212 \approx 79.21\) cubic metres per resident
- Ossbridge: \(3,862,000 \div 52,904 \approx 72.998\) cubic metres per resident

Difference in water use: approximately \(6.212\) cubic metres per resident. At 142.35 tenge per cubic metre, the difference is approximately 884.26 tenge, which rounds to 884.

ANSWER: Harrowfield | 884
